Delicious Pizza in HCM
Dec 2024 • Friends
I came for dinner here with a good friend last night. We had booked and luckily so, when we arrived there was huge queue . Due to booking, we only needed to wait 5 minutes while they prepared our table and we jumped ahead of the queue.

This particular 4Ps is huge, over two levels and it was packed totally on a Thursday night. Testimony to how popular they have become. They are definitely the best Pizza restaurant chain in Vietnam. Their salads and pasta dishes are good too. Definitely try the spaghetti with crab if you get a chance, simply delicious.

Service is pretty good, ordering is by scanning a QR code to bring up the menu on your smart phone and ordering directly. Considering how crowded they were last night, the wait was totally reasonable and not long, the food was delicious.

For tourists, please note: it is not easy to find at first. There is only a small sign for Pizza 4P at the top of the laneway. The laneway has a Japanese Sake Pub at the corner. Walk down the laneway, past all the parked bikes till you get to the end and to your left is the entrance… you can’t miss it when you walk down to the end of the laneway.

The location is hidden in the back of a small alley on HBT street. It did give off some kind of a sense of adventure discovering a hidden gem in what seemed to be a warehouse. The restaurant is located on the first floor that you have to walk through a lovely garden to get to the stairs. 

We didn't make any reservation so there was no table left at 6:30 PM on a weeknight. The staffs quickly informed us that they only have counter seats and we were both fine with that. The dim light made it hard to read the menu though but it went perfectly great with the cozy atmosphere.

We ordered clam chowder for starter, then their best seller crab pasta which tasted heavenly good as our side dish. We shared a half-half pizza for main course: shrimp and broccoli half (with cheese) and beef half (no cheese). Lemonade was out of stock since it's summertime so we went with fresh orange juice and mojito ale which tasted absolutely amazing too. 

Drinks were free since we have coupons. The restaurant accepts payment via credit/debit cards too so it's very convenient. We would definitely come back in the near future to explore more options on pizza.
